entry.content: publish: description, inputSchema +`platformText` ({ twitter: "…", linkedin: "…" }) gives each platform its own caption, as update_scheduled_post takes it (saved on the draft with contentId); unknown arguments are refused (422 unknown_fields). parameters: +input.platformText input.platformText description: Per-platform captions for this post, the same shape, validation and limits as PATCH /api/v2/posts/{id}: { "twitter": "…" } gives X its own caption, null / "" clears one, null clears them all; an over-limit caption is a 422. With contentId they are merged into the item's stored captions and saved on it first (so a later edit, re-book or review uses the same ones); with `content` they apply on top of that text. Platforms without one get the text, auto-fit. Per-platform captions: platform id → the caption that platform gets instead of `text`, e.
